title: AIWG Writing Validation Scoring Configuration
description: Deprecated legacy heuristic weights and diagnostic cutoffs. Not authorship probabilities, quality guarantees or publication gates.

humanMarkerWeight.description: Legacy points per editorial marker (personal statements, metrics, trade-offs); not evidence of human authorship

aiTellPenalty.description: Legacy points per phrase pattern; preserve necessary uncertainty and review context

baseScore.description: Starting deprecated heuristic before marker/pattern adjustments; compatibility value only

criticalPenalty.description: Legacy points per high-priority match; advisory unless an applicable user rule requires it

warningPenalty.description: Points deducted per warning-level issue (minor patterns, style concerns)

aiPatternMultiplier.description: Multiplier for AI pattern score impact on overall score. Lower = less impact from pattern density.

aiPatternNormalizer.description: Normalizer for AI pattern density calculation: (patternCount / (wordCount/100)) * normalizer. Higher = stricter.

mixedVoiceThreshold.description: Ratio threshold for voice detection. If top voice score is not 1.5x higher than second, classify as 'mixed'.

defaultMixedConfidence.description: Confidence percentage assigned when voice is classified as 'mixed'.

strong.description: Points per strong voice marker match (distinctive phrases, key terminology)

moderate.description: Points per moderate voice marker match (tone indicators, common patterns)

weak.description: Points per weak voice marker match (general style hints)

passScore.description: Deprecated diagnostic cutoff retained for compatibility; not a publication gate

lowScoreWarning.description: Score below which to show low-score warnings

highAIPatternWarning.description: Deprecated phrase-density cutoff for contextual review; not an authorship signal or removal quota

_notes.tuning: Higher penalties change the legacy heuristic. Assess labeled findings by language and context before tuning; selected examples do not establish population error rates.
_notes.rationale: Historical defaults retained for compatibility. The 10/15 weights assign 1.5x penalty versus reward; no controlled evidence or calibrated authorship inference is established by this configuration.
